factSignals.claim: Live PTY sessions live in one module-level registry keyed by session id — new Map<string, PtyRecord>() at module scope — rather than being tracked per window.
Resizing is an explicit operation on a session id: resizePty takes the column and row counts, so geometry changes are not a side effect of rendering.
Shutdown is graceful-then-forced on a fixed budget, GRACEFUL_KILL_TIMEOUT_MS, which is 3000 milliseconds.
The kill helper gracefulKillProc takes that budget as a default parameter, so an individual caller can shorten or lengthen it without editing the shared constan
